system.description: (Requires Letter of the Law) A law-breaker receives a citation once the break resolves: the next damage they take is increased by (SL × 2) — (SL × 5) if that damage came from breaking another law — then the citation is removed. Cited damage ignores Resistances, as printed. All citations clear at scene's end.
